intro: Kalyan and Dombivli sit about 28 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes the twin city one of the closest large markets we serve. FunPlay Systems has made outdoor playground equipment since 2002. Every slide, swing and play tower for Kalyan Dombivli is built in our own 45,000 sq ft unit and then travels by road to your site.

Most enquiries from here come from builders finishing new towers, from older societies that are being redeveloped and want a fresh garden, and from schools along the Central Railway line. We help each of them choose equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and install the pieces with our own team. Most projects start with a phone call and a few photos.

sections.h: Play areas for new towers in Kalyan and Dombivli
sections.html:
Many new projects in Kalyan West, Dombivli East and along the Kalyan Shil Road keep the children's area on a podium or in a narrow strip between buildings. A podium slab cannot be dug for foundations, so we use the self-standing method there and lay rubber flooring on top. On open ground we grout the posts into concrete.

For tight spaces, a compact unit from our Play Lands multi play stations puts slides, a climber and a deck into one footprint. Builders like that it photographs well for the sales brochure and is ready before possession.

Kalyan Dombivli gets heavy rain from June to September, and low ground near the Ulhas river and the creek can hold water for days. Raise the play area a little above the garden level and give it a slope towards a drain. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts cope well with months of wet weather, because the zinc coating protects the steel and plastic does not rust.

After the rains, check bolts and spring riders, and wash off the silt that settles on slides. Our after sales team can guide your society staff on these checks.

• Builders who need a finished play area at handover.
  • Housing societies in Dombivli and Kalyan that are replacing old metal swings.
  • Schools that want equipment for nursery and primary sections on one ground.

Gardens run by the Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation also need pieces that can take crowds every evening. For adults and senior citizens in the same garden, see our outdoor gym equipment in Kalyan Dombivli.

Many older societies in Dombivli still have rusted swings and broken slides. We can plan new pieces that use the same open space and keep the garden in use during the change.

We have installed play equipment for Raymond in Thane, a short drive from Kalyan. A Kalyan Dombivli project follows the same steps. You send the site size, the age group and a few photos, we send a layout and a quote, and once you approve, we manufacture, dispatch and install.

Because the distance is short, it is easy for your committee or site engineer to plan the installation day around other work on the site.

faq.q: How far is your factory from Kalyan Dombivli?
faq.a: Our factory is in Vasai East, about 28 km away. We make the equipment there, send it by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on a podium slab?
faq.a: Yes. On a podium we use the self-standing method so the slab is not drilled for deep foundations, and we usually suggest rubber flooring under the equipment to cushion falls.

faq.q: What warranty do you give?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

faq.q: Our society garden is small. What can fit?
faq.a: Share the length and width of the garden and the age of the children who will use it. We will suggest a few pieces or one compact play station and mark the safe play area on a drawing.

intro: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment across Kerala and Tamil Nadu, from apartment projects in Kochi and Chennai to schools in Madurai and Coimbatore and resorts in the hills. We design and make every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, where we have worked since 2002. The equipment reaches the south by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer in the region.

The two states share a long coastline and two monsoons, yet the conditions on a site in Alappuzha are very different from those in Tiruchirappalli or Ooty. Humidity and salt air decide the choice of materials on the coast, while the dry interior of Tamil Nadu raises questions of heat and shade. Hill sites need a firm base on sloping ground. We plan each layout with these differences in mind, and send a drawing with the safe play area marked before anything is made.

sections.h: Supplying the coast, the plains and the hills
sections.html:
On the Kerala coast and in Chennai, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up best against humid, salty air. We suggest rinsing the equipment now and then and following the maintenance steps we give at handover. In the plains of Tamil Nadu, around Madurai, Tiruchirappalli and Salem, summers are long and hot, so shade over slides and decks matters as much as the equipment itself.

For hill stations in the Western Ghats, such as Munnar, Ooty and Kodaikanal, the ground is often uneven. We level the base and choose grouting where the soil is soft. City pages such as Kochi and Madurai go into more local detail.

sections.h: Who buys playground equipment in the south
sections.html:
Builders in Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Chennai and Coimbatore want a finished play area for apartment and villa projects. CBSE, ICSE and state board schools ask for equipment that serves several age groups on one ground. Resorts and homestays along the backwaters, and in the hills, look for a feature piece that families remember, and we have installed a resort playground near Dindigul.

Parks run by city corporations need equipment that takes heavy evening crowds. Designs from our Funplay Originals range, many inspired by Indian games and nature, work well where a school or resort wants something different from a standard slide and swing set.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Kerala and Tamil Nadu?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai and send the equipment by road. Our installation team or a dealer in the region sets it up on your site. Share your town and site photos first, so we can plan dispatch and the installation day together.

faq.q: Which materials suit humid coastal sites?
faq.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts, because plastic does not rust and the zinc coating protects the steel. Rinse the equipment from time to time if the site is close to the sea.

faq.q: Can you install on sloping ground in the hills?
faq.a: Yes. We look at the site photos and levels, prepare a level base and use grouting or the self-standing method depending on the soil. The layout drawing shows the safe play area around each piece.

faq.q: What does the warranty cover?
faq.a: It covers manufacturing defects. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry three years, and springs, bearings and spare parts carry one year, provided installation and upkeep follow our instructions.

intro: Khora, on the Ghaziabad side of the Noida border, is one of the most densely built areas in the National Capital Region. Open ground is scarce, so a play area here usually has to fit into a school courtyard, a society corner or a small park. FunPlay Systems designs equipment that works in such spaces and supplies it from our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away.

We have been manufacturing outdoor playground equipment since 2002. For Khora and the rest of Ghaziabad we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India. You share the plot size and a few photos, and we reply with a layout drawing that shows how much safe play area each piece needs.

sections.h: Making the most of a small plot
sections.html:
On a small plot, one combined play station often works better than several separate pieces, because it shares a single safe zone. A unit with a slide, a climbing wall and a deck can keep a group of children busy in a space where two swings would barely fit. Our Play Lands and themed play stations come in several sizes.

Where the space is a long strip, a row of spring riders and a see-saw can work. Keep the equipment away from boundary walls and gates, and mark the safe area clearly so parked bikes do not creep into it.

sections.h: Heat, dust and cold in the NCR
sections.html:
Ghaziabad summers are very hot and dusty, and winter mornings can be cold and foggy. Plastic slides in direct sun get hot by afternoon, so place them facing away from the west or plan a shade sail. Roto-moulded parts keep their colour well, and we offer more than 15 shades.

Dust settles on everything here. A wash with plain water once a week keeps slides smooth and stops grit wearing the surfaces. During the July to September rains, check that water drains away from the posts.

Most buyers in Khora are private schools that need equipment for nursery and primary children, and housing societies that want a safe corner for younger residents. Small parks and community spaces also call us.

If you are planning a larger site in the area, our pages for Noida and Ghaziabad cover the wider district. Adults in the same society can use an open-air gym, and our outdoor gym equipment in Khora page explains the options.

1. Send the plot size, a few photos and the age group of the children.
  2. We suggest equipment and share a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.
  3. Once you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture at Vasai.
  4. The equipment goes by road and is installed by our team or a dealer.

In crowded lanes, tell us about access to the site in advance, so the installation crew can plan how to bring the parts in.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Khora, Ghaziabad?
faq.a: Yes. We make the equipment at our Vasai factory and send it by road. Our installation team or a dealer in north India installs it on your site. Tell us about lane width and gate size, since that decides how the larger parts are carried in.

faq.q: What equipment fits a very small school courtyard?
faq.a: A compact multi play station or two or three individual pieces such as spring riders and a small slide. Send us the length and width and we will suggest options with the safe area marked.

faq.q: Will plastic slides get too hot in the Ghaziabad summer?
faq.a: Any surface in direct afternoon sun gets hot. Face slides away from the west where possible, or add shade, and the equipment stays usable through most of the day. Lighter colours also stay cooler than dark ones.

faq.q: How do we keep the equipment clean in a dusty area?
faq.a: Wash it with plain water regularly and check bolts every few months. We share simple maintenance steps at handover, and our after sales team can help if a part needs attention.

/outdoor-playground-equipment-manufactur.notes: Little reliable local detail about Khora beyond its location on the Noida and Ghaziabad border and dense housing; kept to practical small-site advice and NCR climate.

intro: Kochi is a port city built around backwaters, and that shapes how a playground should be made here. Salt air, high humidity and one of the heaviest monsoons in India test every bolt and surface. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,110 km away, with galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic chosen for exactly these conditions.

We supply apartment builders in Kakkanad, Edappally and the suburbs, schools across Ernakulam district, and resorts and homestays that want a play corner for visiting families. The equipment goes from Vasai by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in the south. Since 2002 we have completed more than 15,000 installations across India, and the same process and warranty apply to a site in Kochi as to one near our factory.

sections.h: Equipment that handles salt air and rain
sections.html:
The southwest monsoon reaches Kerala in early June and stays for months, and the northeast monsoon brings more rain later in the year. Bare mild steel rusts quickly in this climate. Our posts are galvanised, so the zinc layer protects the steel, and our slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic that does not rust at all.

Near the backwaters or the sea, rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time. Lay the play area on a raised, well-drained base, because flat ground in Kochi can stay waterlogged after a heavy spell.

Apartment projects often want a single multi play station with a slide, a climber and a deck, which fits a podium or a garden strip. Schools ask for separate pieces for different age groups, such as swings, a see-saw and a climbing frame. Resorts usually look for a design that stands out.

Our Nature Sparsh play stations, inspired by nature, suit resort lawns well. Larger campuses can look at the NexLev series of bigger play towers.

1. Send us the site size, photos and the age group of the children.
  2. We suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.
  3. After you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture at Vasai.
  4. We dispatch by road and install with the self-standing or grouting method.

For residents who also want exercise equipment, see our outdoor gym equipment in Kochi.

Share photos taken during the rains if you can, because they show where water collects on the site.

Kochi's long wet season means moss and algae can grow on shaded decks and steps. Scrub these surfaces with mild soap and water every few weeks during the rains, and keep drains around the play area clear of leaves.

Check spring riders, swing hangers and bolts after each monsoon. Springs and bearings carry a one-year warranty and are the parts that see the most wear. Our after sales team on +91 738 530 0921 can help if anything needs replacing.

faq.q: Is your playground equipment suitable for Kochi's coastal climate?
faq.a: Yes. We use galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts, which resist rust in humid, salty air. Rinsing with fresh water now and then and following our maintenance steps helps the equipment last.

faq.q: Do you deliver and install in Kochi?
faq.a: Yes. We make everything at our factory in Vasai and send it to Kochi by road, where our installation team or a dealer in south India sets it up. Installation is easier outside the heaviest rain, so plan the date with that in mind.

faq.q: What surface should go under the equipment in heavy rain?
faq.a: A raised, well-drained base with rubber flooring works best. It cushions falls and dries faster than soil or grass. We can supply the rubber flooring with the equipment. Avoid loose sand on wet sites, as it holds water and washes away.

faq.q: Can resorts get custom colours or designs?
faq.a: Yes. Resorts can choose from more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, and we customise designs on request. Share your idea and site photos and we will suggest what is possible. Resorts often pick colours that sit well with green lawns and water views.

intro: In Kolkata, a neighbourhood park is often used for much more than play. The same ground may host football in the evening, a puja pandal in autumn and a winter fair. FunPlay Systems plans outdoor playground equipment with that kind of shared use in mind. We supply parks, schools and housing complexes across the city from our factory in Vasai, about 1,640 km away.

We have designed and manufactured play equipment since 2002, with in-house roto-moulding and fabrication. For Kolkata, the equipment travels by road and our installation team or a dealer in east India sets it up. Before anything is made, you receive a layout drawing that shows each piece and the safe play area around it.

sections.h: Placing equipment in a busy para park
sections.html:
If your park is used for festivals, keep the play equipment along one edge rather than in the middle. That leaves the open ground free for a pandal or a game and keeps children's equipment away from crowds and temporary wiring. Grouted posts stay firm even when the park is very busy.

Club committees and resident associations often start with swings, a see-saw and a slide, then add a climber later. Our individual equipment range lets you build up a park in stages without redoing the layout.

Kolkata is humid for most of the year, and the monsoon from June to September brings frequent waterlogging. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit these conditions, as plastic does not rust and the zinc layer protects the steel. Raise the play area slightly and give it a drainage slope.

Rubber flooring under the equipment dries faster than grass or mud and cushions falls. We supply it along with the play equipment.

sections.h: Who we supply in and around Kolkata
sections.html:
Builders in New Town, Rajarhat and along the EM Bypass need play areas for large housing complexes. Schools want equipment that can take heavy daily use by many children. Parks run by the Kolkata Municipal Corporation and neighbouring municipalities need equipment for crowds.

We also serve Salt Lake and Bidhannagar and Howrah. For open-air gyms in the same park, see our outdoor gym equipment in Kolkata.

If your society or club has a small budget, start with two or three pieces and plan space for more on the same drawing.

For housing complexes, a themed play station from our Forestia jungle range gives a garden a clear centre. Schools tend to ask for swings, see-saws and spring riders that many children can use at once during a break.

Older parks with mature trees often have patchy light and roots near the surface. We place equipment clear of large roots and low branches, and mark the safe area on the drawing so it stays free of benches and lamp posts.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Kolkata?
faq.a: Yes. Everything is manufactured at our Vasai factory and sent to Kolkata by road. Our installation team or a dealer in east India installs it at your site. Send us the address and photos of the ground, and we will plan the layout before dispatch.

faq.q: Can play equipment stay in a park that is used for pujas?
faq.a: Yes, if you plan for it. Keep the equipment on one side of the ground, grouted firmly, so the open area stays free for events. We can mark this on the layout drawing.

faq.q: How do we handle waterlogging in the monsoon?
faq.a: Build the play area on a slightly raised base with a slope towards a drain, and use rubber flooring under the equipment. Galvanised and roto-moulded parts cope well with wet months.

faq.q: What warranty do you offer?
faq.a: Our structural parts, meaning galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, carry three years. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry one year. Both cover manufacturing defects when our installation and maintenance instructions are followed.

intro: Lucknow has large, planned colonies such as Gomti Nagar, Aliganj and Indira Nagar, each with neighbourhood parks, and a strong base of private schools. Both need outdoor playground equipment that copes with a scorching summer, a damp monsoon and cold, foggy winters. FunPlay Systems makes that equipment at our factory in Vasai and sends it about 1,170 km by road to Lucknow.

We have been designing and manufacturing play equipment since 2002, with our own design, roto-moulding and fabrication teams. In Lucknow, installation is done by our team or a dealer in north India. We start with your site size, the age group and a few photos, and we reply with a layout and a quote. From there, we manufacture, dispatch and install.

sections.html:
From April to June, Lucknow sees intense heat, and plastic and metal in direct sun get hot to the touch. Place slides so they face away from the afternoon sun, or plan shade over the deck. The monsoon brings humid, wet weeks when drainage matters. In December and January, cold mornings and fog keep the equipment damp for hours.

Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle all three seasons well. Rubber flooring under the equipment is better than packed earth, which turns hard in summer and slippery in the rains.

Schools usually need separate zones for nursery and primary children, with low slides, spring riders and a small play station for the youngest, and climbers and swings for older pupils. Our Khel Khud designs, inspired by Indian games, are popular with schools that want group play.

Tell us how many children use the ground during a break, and we will suggest a layout that spreads them across several pieces.

Schools also ask about cleaning. Plastic parts need only a wash with water, which a school's own staff can manage.

Parks run by the municipal corporation and by the Lucknow Development Authority see families every evening, so durable, simple pieces work best there. New apartment projects on the city's edges want a compact play station ready before handover.

We also supply nearby cities such as Kanpur. For adult fitness in the same park, see our outdoor gym equipment in Lucknow.

Many colonies have a park in every sector, so equipment that is easy to maintain matters to the committee that runs it.

Send us the length and width of your ground, a few photos and the age group of the children. We suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and share a quote. After approval, we manufacture at Vasai and dispatch by road.

Choose a colour scheme early. We have more than 15 roto-moulded shades, and schools often match the equipment to their uniform or building colours. Design changes can be made on request before manufacture.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Lucknow?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory, send the equipment to Lucknow by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India. We plan the installation once the ground is ready and the base has been prepared.

faq.q: Which surface is best under play equipment in Lucknow?
faq.a: Rubber flooring on a level, well-drained base. It cushions falls, stays usable in the rains and does not crack like packed earth in the summer heat. We can supply it with the equipment.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground for separate age groups in a school?
faq.a: Yes. Share the size of the ground and the age groups, and we will send a layout with separate zones and the safe play area marked for each piece. Younger children then play apart from older pupils during breaks.

faq.q: What does your warranty cover?
faq.a: Manufacturing defects for three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and for one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, when installed and maintained as instructed.

intro: Ludhiana is Punjab's industrial centre, known for hosiery, bicycles and machine parts, and its buyers tend to look closely at how a product is built. FunPlay Systems welcomes that. Our outdoor playground equipment is designed, roto-moulded and fabricated in-house at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai. We send it about 1,320 km by road to Ludhiana.

Enquiries from the city come from private schools, gated colonies, farmhouse owners and clubs, along with the parks and gardens maintained by the municipal corporation. Our installation team or a dealer in north India sets the equipment up on site. We have been making play equipment since 2002. Every project starts with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area.

sections.html:
Posts and frames are made from galvanised steel pipe, cut and welded in our own fabrication unit. Slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded from plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Raw materials are tested, and each piece goes through quality inspection before dispatch.

That is why we can give three years of warranty on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

sections.h: Punjab's hot summers and cold winters
sections.html:
Ludhiana swings from very hot, dry summers to cold winters with dense fog. Metal and plastic expand and contract with these changes, so have the joints and fixings checked at the end of each season. Rubber flooring under the equipment stays softer than packed earth, which turns hard in both extremes.

Slides in full sun get hot in May and June. Face them north or east where you can, or add shade over the deck.

A school with several sections can use a large play station from the NexLev series alongside individual swings and see-saws. A colony park often needs sturdy single pieces, and a farmhouse lawn might suit a wooden or themed structure.

We also serve Jalandhar and Patiala. For fitness equipment for adults, see our outdoor gym equipment in Ludhiana.

For a large school campus, we can split the order into phases and keep the full layout in one drawing.

• Private schools in the city and along the highways that need equipment for several age groups.
  • Gated colonies and housing projects on the outskirts.
  • Farmhouses and clubs that want a play corner for families.

City parks also need sturdy pieces that can stand daily use without much attention. Whatever the site, we begin with a layout drawing so you can see the space each piece needs before you commit.

Committees often ask for equipment that needs little care. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic need only cleaning and periodic bolt checks.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Ludhiana?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, send the equipment to Ludhiana by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in north India. The process starts with your site size, age group and a few photos.

faq.q: Is the equipment made in your own factory?
faq.a: Yes. Design, roto-moulding and fabrication are all done in-house at our Vasai factory, and every piece is inspected before it is dispatched. You deal directly with the manufacturer, from the first drawing to after sales support.

faq.q: Can you make equipment in our school colours?
faq.a: We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and can customise designs on request. Tell us your colours and we will suggest the closest match. Colour changes are confirmed on the layout before manufacture begins.

faq.q: How is the equipment fixed to the ground?
faq.a: We use either the self-standing method or grouting into concrete, depending on your ground. We decide this after seeing the site photos and the type of surface. Grouting is common on open lawns, while self-standing suits paved or podium areas.

intro: Madurai is one of Tamil Nadu's oldest cities. It grew around the Meenakshi Amman Temple and is today a large education centre for the south of the state, with schools and colleges drawing students from many districts. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to its schools, colleges, housing projects and parks from our factory in Vasai, about 1,190 km away.

We have worked in this part of Tamil Nadu before, with a resort playground in Dindigul, a short drive north of the city. Equipment for Madurai travels by road, and our installation team or a dealer in the south puts it in place. We have been designing and manufacturing play equipment since 2002. Every project starts with a layout and a quote based on your site photos.

sections.h: Planning for heat and strong sun
sections.html:
Madurai stays hot for much of the year, with dry, harsh summers before the rains. Shade is the first thing to plan. Place the play area beside existing trees, or add a shade structure over slides and decks so children can use them in the late afternoon.

Roto-moulded plastic keeps its colour well under strong sun, and galvanised steel posts do not rust when the northeast monsoon arrives. Rubber flooring under the equipment is cooler and softer than bare concrete.

Our resort playground in Dindigul shows the kind of work we do for hospitality clients in the region. Resorts want equipment that looks good on a lawn and keeps children busy while parents relax.

For similar sites, our Funplay Originals range offers play structures designed by our own team, many inspired by Indian games and nature. They stand out more than a standard slide and swing.

Resorts usually want the play area within sight of a seating spot, so parents can watch while they rest.

sections.h: Schools, colleges and housing in Madurai
sections.html:
• Matriculation, CBSE and state board schools that want equipment for several age groups.
  • New apartment and villa projects on the city's outskirts.
  • Parks and public spaces maintained by the corporation.

For adult fitness in a park or campus, see our outdoor gym equipment in Madurai. We also serve Dindigul, Tiruchirappalli and Tirunelveli, and the same layout and installation process applies across the region.

Colleges with day-care centres for staff children can use a small play corner too.

You share the site size, photos and the age group of the children. We then propose equipment and draw a layout that shows the safe play area. Once you approve the layout and the quote, we manufacture the equipment at Vasai and send it south by road.

Installation is done with the self-standing method or by grouting the posts into concrete, depending on your ground. Much of the soil around Madurai is hard and dry, which suits grouting well.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Madurai?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our Vasai factory and send the equipment to Madurai by road. Our installation team or a dealer in south India installs it. Our team plans the installation once your base is ready.

faq.q: Have you done projects near Madurai?
faq.a: Yes. We installed a resort playground in Dindigul. You can see it on our projects page, and we can plan something similar for a school, resort or housing site in Madurai.

faq.q: How do we keep the equipment usable in the summer heat?
faq.a: Place it under trees or add shade over slides and decks, and use rubber flooring instead of bare concrete. Roto-moulded plastic holds its colour well in strong sun. Schedule busy play times for the morning and evening when you can.

faq.q: What information do you need for a quote?
faq.a: The size of the site, the age group of the children and a few photos. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, along with a quote.

intro: Nagpur summers are among the hottest in India, and anyone planning a playground here should start with the sun. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to Nagpur's schools, housing societies and public gardens from our factory in Vasai, about 670 km away on the other side of Maharashtra.

We have been making play equipment since 2002 and have more than 15,000 installations across India. For Nagpur and the wider Vidarbha region, we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer. Before we manufacture anything, you see a layout drawing with the safe play area marked for every piece, so the committee can approve the plan knowing how much space it needs.

sections.html:
From April to early June, afternoon temperatures in Nagpur make bare metal and dark plastic uncomfortable to touch. Choose lighter colours for slides and decks, and place them facing north or east. A shade structure over the main play station lets children use it in the evening without waiting for the surface to cool.

Rubber flooring stays softer and cooler than concrete or hard, dry earth. Water the surrounding lawn in the evening, not the equipment, so moving parts do not stay wet.

Nagpur's schools often have large grounds, so they can place separate zones for nursery and primary children. Housing societies in the newer areas around the city usually want a compact play station near the clubhouse.

Our Play Lands multi play stations combine slides, climbers and decks in one unit. Schools that want something different can look at the Timeless Play structures from our Funplay Originals range.

Clubhouse play areas work best when parents can sit nearby in the shade, so plan benches into the layout from the start.

Gardens maintained by the Nagpur Municipal Corporation see heavy evening use once the heat drops. Simple, sturdy pieces such as swings, see-saws and merry-go-rounds suit them, grouted into concrete so they stay firm. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic come through the July to September monsoon without rusting.

For adults and walkers in the same garden, see our outdoor gym equipment in Nagpur. In Maharashtra we have also completed a project for Raymond in Thane.

Most Nagpur projects start with a few site photos sent on email or phone. We reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing. Once the layout and quote are approved, our factory makes the equipment and dispatches it by road across Maharashtra.

Our team or a local dealer installs it with the method that suits your ground. Hard, dry soil is common in the region, and grouting into a concrete base keeps the posts firm through the year.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Nagpur?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, send the equipment to Nagpur by road and install it with our own installation team or a local dealer. Vidarbha sites are reached by road from Vasai across the state.

faq.q: Will the equipment get too hot in Nagpur's summer?
faq.a: Any surface in direct sun gets hot. Choose lighter colours, place slides away from the afternoon sun and add shade over the main structure. Children can then use it comfortably in the evening.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a large school ground?
faq.a: A multi play station for younger children, and swings, climbers and see-saws for older pupils, spread across separate zones. Share the ground size and we will propose a layout.

faq.q: What warranty do you give?
faq.a: The frame and plastic parts are covered for three years, including galvanised pipes, composite laminates and play rope. Springs and bearings are covered for one year. The cover is for manufacturing defects on equipment installed and maintained our way.

intro: Nashik has grown fast along the Mumbai highway, with new housing on the city's edges and a wide spread of schools. It also draws a steady flow of pilgrims to the Godavari ghats and to Trimbakeshwar nearby. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to all of these from our factory in Vasai, about 120 km away.

That short distance helps. Our equipment reaches Nashik by road and is installed by our team or a dealer near you, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits the ground. We have been manufacturing play equipment since 2002, with design, roto-moulding and fabrication done in our own factory. Many Nashik projects begin with a phone call and a few photos of the site.

sections.h: Nashik's climate and what it means for equipment
sections.html:
Nashik is milder than much of Maharashtra, but it still gets hot, dry summers and a strong monsoon from June to September. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded plastic handle both. Much of the ground around the city is hard and rocky, and we grout posts into concrete where digging is limited.

Winters are cool and pleasant, so outdoor play areas see good use for most of the year. Plan a raised, well-drained base for the rainy months.

Nashik's dry season also brings dust. A quick wash with water keeps slides smooth and the colours clear.

Builders on Gangapur Road, in Indira Nagar and around the city want a finished play area that buyers can see at the site visit. A single themed play station often works better than scattered pieces. Our Castle Crest and Forestia ranges give a strong look in a modest footprint.

We worked on a project for Raymond in Thane, and the same process applies to a Nashik township: layout, approval, manufacture, dispatch and installation.

Nashik's many schools and colleges need equipment that takes heavy daily use. Resorts and farm stays in the vineyard belt around the city look for a play corner for visiting families. Gardens maintained by the Nashik Municipal Corporation need simple, durable pieces.

For open-air fitness equipment in the same space, see our outdoor gym equipment in Nashik.

Temple trusts and dharamshalas around Nashik that set aside space for children can follow the same planning steps.

For children under six, low slides, spring riders and a small play station keep things simple. Children from six to twelve want climbing, balancing and faster slides. A climber or climbing frame next to a swing set gives that group plenty to do.

If your site serves both ages, keep the zones apart so younger children are not run into by older ones. Our layout drawing will show the safe play area for each zone.

faq.q: How far is your factory from Nashik?
faq.a: About 120 km. We make the equipment at our factory in Vasai East, send it to Nashik by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

faq.q: Can you install on rocky ground?
faq.a: Yes. Where digging is difficult, we grout the posts into a concrete base or use the self-standing method. We decide after seeing site photos. Hard murum soil around the city often suits grouting.

faq.q: Do you make themed play stations for townships?
faq.a: Yes. Our CoreCraft range includes castle, jungle, circus and robot themes, and we can customise designs and colours on request from more than 15 roto-moulded shades. The layout drawing shows how the chosen theme fits your space.

faq.q: What warranty comes with the equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, for manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as instructed.
